title: the push guard judges a push in the session's clone, not the clone it runs in
status: fixed after 0.5.0: the guard judges each push in the clone it runs in (DESIGN.md, 13)
world: memory; the git world runs it over real git (build step 6)

steps.note: b fetches in its second clone, b-other, makes a claim commit naming itself there, and runs git -C ../b-other push --force-with-lease origin claude/1 from its session's clone, which never fetched claude/1: git would take the lease from b-other, and the guard, judging the push in b-other, reads a's claim file on origin/claude/1 and b's on the branch pushed and refuses it; under the mutant that asks the session's own clone, which shows no claim file on origin/claude/1, the fence cannot judge, the lease is taken and G11a and G1 are red here

the same push by cd ../b-other && git push --force-with-lease origin claude/1: the guard follows the shell's cd into b-other and refuses it; under the mutant that does not follow the shell's moves the push is judged in the session's clone, taken, and G11a and G1 are red here
